fields.Name: T277 - Home Add Pin Panel Search Filters Catalog
fields.Description: Exercises the FilterPanelItems() / FilterApps() client-side name filter over the loaded catalog — a distinct search-responsiveness code path, separate from the global Ctrl+K search and the entity grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). In the 'Pinned' section click 'Add Pin' to open the slide-in panel and wait for the resource catalog to load. Type a short query into the panel's search box ('Search apps, dashboards, views, queries...') — for example a few letters likely to match an application or dashboard name. Verify the accordion sections RESPOND to the filter: the visible pinnable items narrow to those whose names contain your text, OR sections with no matches disappear, OR a clear empty result appears. Then clear the search and verify the fuller list returns. Success is that the list visibly reacts to the typed text — it is data-agnostic. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the Add Pin panel search box narrows the catalog items to name matches (or collapses non-matching sections / shows an empty result)
Clearing the search restores a broader list of pinnable items
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
